import json
import os

path = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/ji-host/data/host-identity.json")
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as source:
    value = json.load(source)
for index, device in enumerate(value.get("devices", [])):
    print(f"device[{index}].keys=" + ",".join(sorted(device.keys())))
    print(f"device[{index}].authAlgorithm=" + str(device.get("authAlgorithm")))
    print(f"device[{index}].role=" + str(device.get("role")))
    print(f"device[{index}].revision=" + str(device.get("revision")))
    print(f"device[{index}].revokedAtPresent=" + str(bool(device.get("revokedAt"))))
